
```{r}

library(cowplot)
library(httpgd)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(yardstick)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(vroom)


sim_blasto_mixtures_dat <- 
vroom("simulation_runs/sim_all_euk_genome_mixtures/all_euk_genome_mapping.csv") %>%
    select(species, taxid, acc, full_acc) %>%
    filter(str_detect(species, "nmh|bt1|nand ii|subtype 2")) %>%
    mutate(taxa = case_when(
        str_detect(species, "nmh") ~ "Blastocystis ST3",
        str_detect(species, "bt1") ~ "Blastocystis ST4",
        str_detect(species, "nand ii") ~ "Blastocystis ST1",
        str_detect(species, "subtype 2") ~ "Blastocystis ST2"
    ))


set.seed(123)
sim_blasto_mix_mapping <-
    tibble(
        mix_id = rep(c(0:1000), each = 4),
        taxa = rep(pull(sim_blasto_mixtures_dat, taxa), times = 1001),
    ) %>%
    # group_by()
    mutate(
        sim_fcov = exp(runif(n(), log(1e-3), log(1))),
        normalized_fcov = sim_fcov / sum(sim_fcov)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(sim_fcov = ifelse(mix_id == 0, 0.25, sim_fcov)) %>%
    mutate(normalized_fcov = ifelse(mix_id == 0, 0.25, normalized_fcov)) %>%
    left_join(sim_blasto_mixtures_dat, by = "taxa")


sim_blasto_mix_mapping %>%
    write_csv("/storage/home/hcoda1/1/jshih41/scratch/final_eukdetect2_sims/simulation_runs/sim_blasto_mixtures/blasto_mix_mapping.csv")


sim_blasto_mix_mapping %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = sim_fcov)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
        scale_x_log10()

```
